name: 持ち帰る食事の包装と持参する袋の案内
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Correct ONE Japanese Lighthouse packaging notice LH19-0022. Image1 ORIGINAL source highest authority for fine detail/informational hierarchy. Image2 Japanese mock secondary copy/compact wrapping. Image3 v001 correction target. Image4 white-card style only.
Targeted correction: restore compact phone-width wrapping; DO NOT stretch long paragraph into one line or shrink its font. Card has logical width390px, body content358px, rendered at large consistent scale. Exact body lines MUST be:
「食事の包装はお店で用意します。」
「自宅へ持ち帰るための袋は、ご自身で持参することをお」
「すすめします。」
Keep small regular label「持ち帰りの包装」above these three body lines. Match mock line breaks even where sentence continues across lines. Locked Meiryo labelRegular12/16, bodyRegular14/24, tracking0, no display heading/bold. Preserve original neutral no-icon/no-action state, clear provided packaging versus recommended carry bag. Pure white#FFFFFF canvas/card, fine neutral rounded border, extremely soft shadow, modest compact padding. Crop image framing close to card, no huge outside whitespace. Text complete, no clipping, no green accent/CTA/illustration, no new claim or content.
reviewNotes: 2回目を実見。日本語の見出しRegularと本文3行の折返しを指定へ修正、店舗が包装を用意し持参袋を推奨する意味と全文を維持。中立情報のためアクセント・アイコン・操作を追加せず白面／ニュートラル境界／控えめな影を確認。欠けなし。厳密フォント数値・所有者承認・ネイティブ編集・動作は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
